summary: A forest fall two kilometres from Medha's cascades on the Dang–Tapi line — the border belt's quiet extra drop, name and all.
description:
Soul to Prakriti marks a real drop in the forest country of the northern border belt, barely two kilometres from the Medha (Ekva Golan) cascades — the name confirmed by a traveller who has visited. Treat the two as one outing: the same forest roads, the same monsoon window, the same mist-hung hills that make this belt the district line's best-kept stretch.

No written source describes it beyond the pin; expect the belt's standard bargain — real beauty, zero facilities — and take local guidance for the walk in.
highlights: Two kilometres from Medha falls — one outing, two drops
Completely undocumented beyond its map pin

modes.road: The Medha/Ekva Golan forest roads off the Songadh side; the Ahwa–Songadh road serves it from the south
modes.rail: Songadh/Vyara stations on the Surat–Bhusawal line

access.last_mile: Forest walk from the road end; unmarked

experience.photography_notes: Mist moves through this belt all monsoon — work the clearings.

amenities.guides: Take local guidance — paths are unmarked

warnings: Unmarked forest paths — do not explore alone
Slick rock and surging flow through the monsoon

tips: Do it with Medha falls — the pins are two kilometres apart
